pattern: IM-T08 tenant confirms the self-help fix worked; IM-P04 close without payment; OE over-escalation trap
notes: Real cut of the source, no edits: the agent sees events 001-011, ending with the tenant's confirmation that the extractor fan works after locating the button. The recorded next events are the email telling the tenant the job will be closed (012), the note (013) and "Task has been completed without payment" (014).
